zh: 先看數線上的七個點：A 在兩側、B 在中間；再看黃色虛線的最佳單一門檻 x = 1.5，紅圈是分錯的 2 個點：只能分對 5 筆。〔功能：1〕
夾住的類別：一維數線上的七個點與最好的單一門檻 x = 1.5，只能分對 7 筆中的 5 筆。
en: First see the seven points on the number line: A on both sides and B in the middle; then see the best single threshold x = 1.5 as the yellow dashed line, with the two mistakes ringed in red: only 5 are right. [Function: 1]
Sandwiched classes: seven points on a number line and the best single threshold x = 1.5, which gets only 5 of 7 right.

zh: 先看左邊逐點算 (x, x²) 的表；再看右邊七個點升到 (x, x²) 後的位置：A 在上方、B 在下方，一條水平線 y₂ = 2.5 把兩群分開。〔功能：1、2〕
七個點升到 (x, x²) 後被水平線 y₂ = 2.5 分開：A 的 y₂ 都不小於 4，B 的都不大於 1。
en: First see the table of (x, x²) point by point on the left; then see the seven points lifted to (x, x²) on the right: A above, B below, and one horizontal line y₂ = 2.5 separates the two groups. [Function: 1, 2]
The seven points lifted to (x, x²) are separated by the horizontal line y₂ = 2.5: every A has y₂ ≥ 4 and every B has y₂ ≤ 1.

zh: 先看拋物線 g(x) = −2.5 + x² 與七個點；再看它與 x 軸的兩個交點 ±1.58：外側 g > 0 是 A，中間 g < 0 是 B；右邊是廣義線性分類器的定義與三步推導。〔功能：2〕
回到 x 看是彎的：g(x) = −2.5 + x² 與七個點，邊界在 x = ±1.58。
en: First see the parabola g(x) = −2.5 + x² and the seven points; then see its two crossings with the x axis at ±1.58: outside, g > 0 is A, and in the middle g < 0 is B; the right side gives the definition of a generalized linear classifier and the three-step derivation. [Function: 2]
Back in x it is curved: g(x) = −2.5 + x² with the seven points, boundary at x = ±1.58.

zh: 先看左邊：XOR 的四個點在原座標分不開；再看中間：加上 y₃ = x₁x₂ 後從側面（x₁ + x₂ 與 y₃）看，一條線把 A 與 B 分開；右邊的表逐點算 g = x₁ + x₂ − 2y₃ − 0.5：−0.5、+0.5、+0.5、−0.5。〔功能：2〕
XOR 四個點加一個座標 y₃ = x₁x₂ 後，g = x₁ + x₂ − 2y₃ − 0.5 的值為 −0.5、+0.5、+0.5、−0.5，一個平面分開兩類。
en: First see the left: the four XOR points cannot be separated in the original coordinates; then see the middle: after adding y₃ = x₁x₂, a side view (x₁ + x₂ against y₃) shows one line separating A from B; the table on the right computes g = x₁ + x₂ − 2y₃ − 0.5 point by point: −0.5, +0.5, +0.5, −0.5. [Function: 2]
After adding the coordinate y₃ = x₁x₂ to the four XOR points, g = x₁ + x₂ − 2y₃ − 0.5 takes the values −0.5, +0.5, +0.5, −0.5 and one plane separates the classes.

zh: 先看左邊的正規方程與 Φ、t 的樣子，以及解出的 w = (−0.810, 0, 0.238)；再看右邊七個點的 g 值逐點比對正負號：全部和目標同號。〔功能：2〕
最小二乘權重 w = (−0.810, 0, 0.238)：七個點的 g 值正負都和目標相同。
en: First see the normal equation on the left with the shape of Φ and t and the solved w = (−0.810, 0, 0.238); then see the g values of the seven points on the right compared sign by sign: all match the targets. [Function: 2]
Least-squares weights w = (−0.810, 0, 0.238): the g values of the seven points all have the sign of their target.

zh: 先看左邊兩圈散點與綠色的決策圓；再讀右邊的表：直線特徵 102 筆（51%）、二次特徵 199 筆（99.5%），圓的半徑約 1.71，以及二次特徵的個數 5、65、5150。〔功能：1、3〕
同心環散點圖與半徑約 1.71 的決策圓：直線特徵 51%，二次特徵 99.5%。
en: First see the two rings of points on the left with the green decision circle; then read the table on the right: linear features 102 right (51%), quadratic features 199 right (99.5%), a circle of radius about 1.71, and the numbers of quadratic features 5, 65, 5150. [Function: 1, 3]
Concentric rings with the decision circle of radius about 1.71: linear features 51%, quadratic features 99.5%.

zh: 先看三條 g 曲線，每個區段最高的那條就是判定的類（底部色帶）；再看九個點是否落在對應類最高的區段；右邊是做法與結果：九筆全對，只用 (1, x) 只對 7 筆。〔功能：2〕
多類別：三條 g 曲線與九個點；(1, x, x²) 九筆全對，只用 (1, x) 只對 7 筆。
en: First see the three g curves, where the highest curve in each stretch is the chosen class (the strip at the bottom); then see whether the nine points fall in the stretch of their own class; the right side gives the method and result: all nine right, and only 7 with just (1, x). [Function: 2]
Multi-class: three g curves and nine points; all nine right with (1, x, x²), only 7 with just (1, x).

zh: 先看上下兩列方塊圖：上列映射 fᵢ 固定、只學 w；下列先學方向 wᵢ 再配函數 fᵢ；再讀右邊的加倍測試：廣義線性剛好加倍，投影追蹤不是（f(2) = 0.881，2f(1) = 1.462）。〔功能：2〕
廣義線性與投影追蹤：兩種結構的方塊圖與加倍測試。
en: First see the two rows of block diagrams: in the top row the mapping fᵢ is fixed and only w is learned; in the bottom row the direction wᵢ is learned and then the function fᵢ is fitted; then read the doubling test on the right: the generalized linear classifier exactly doubles and projection pursuit does not (f(2) = 0.881 against 2f(1) = 1.462). [Function: 2]
Generalized linear versus projection pursuit: block diagrams of the two structures and the doubling test.

zh: 左邊是題 1：(1,1) 屬 B、(3,0) 與 (0,−2.5) 屬 A；右邊是題 2：g = 0 是半徑 2 的圓，各附核對。〔功能：3〕
兩題小練習與解題示範：三點的類別與 g = 0 的圓。
en: The left is Q1: (1,1) is B and (3,0), (0,−2.5) are A; the right is Q2: g = 0 is a circle of radius 2, each with its check. [Function: 3]
Two exercises with worked answers: the classes of three points and the circle g = 0.
